governance.urgency: P0 blocker or integrity risk; P1 critical foundation or leverage; P2 subsequent work
governance.architecture_impact: 0 unrelated to core; 1 local; 2 shared component; 3 cross-project foundation
governance.leverage: 0 narrow; 1 local; 2 reused in several contexts; 3 many downstream tasks unblocked
governance.accountability: nils_editorial_decision = explicit author/publisher choice; research_plus_nils_decision = evidence first and sign-off; automation_with_nils_approval = execution can be automated with human approval; public_candidate = possible external task after review
governance.prompt_spec_status: not_prepared / meta_draft_in_repo / topic_prompt_in_source_document are document availability states, not testing
governance.prompt_execution_status: none_verified means no recorded prompt trial linked to this row; does NOT mean the underlying scientific/model code was never run
governance.editorial_release: not_approved for all public prompt releases in this registry
